entries.title: 最便宜套餐排行榜与月度价格月报上线，新收录 3 个国际品牌
entries.title_en: Cheapest-plan ranking and monthly price report launched, plus 3 newly listed international brands
entries.summary: 新增按月费排序的最便宜套餐排行榜和 2026 年 7 月价格月报，并收录 GitHub Copilot、Ollama、StreamLake 三个国际品牌的 Coding 套餐。
entries.summary_en: Added a cheapest-plan ranking sorted by monthly price and the July 2026 price report, and listed coding plans from GitHub Copilot, Ollama, and StreamLake.
items: 新增「最便宜套餐排行榜」页面，按月费从低到高排序国际 AI Coding 套餐。
新增「月度价格报告」栏目，首期发布 2026 年 7 月 AI Coding 套餐价格月报。
新收录 3 个国际品牌：GitHub Copilot、Ollama、StreamLake，品牌页与套餐详情页同步上线。
品牌页补全品牌介绍文案，帮助快速了解各平台定位与适用场景。
数据修复：套餐与模型关联关系校正、StepFun 模型展示名回填、套餐数据例行审计。
items_en: Added a "Cheapest plans" ranking page sorting international AI coding plans by monthly price.
Launched the monthly price report section, starting with the July 2026 AI coding plan price report.
Listed 3 new international brands: GitHub Copilot, Ollama, and StreamLake, with brand and plan detail pages.
Completed brand intro copy on brand pages for a quick overview of each platform.
Data fixes: corrected plan-model links, backfilled StepFun model display names, and ran routine plan data audits.

entries.title: 套餐对比升级：额度、性价比、可购买筛选，并公开反馈路线图
entries.title_en: Plan comparison upgrade: quota, value ranking, purchasable filter, and a public roadmap
entries.summary: 根据用户高频反馈集中升级套餐对比能力，并公开「正在推进」路线图。
entries.summary_en: A focused upgrade to plan comparison based on user feedback, plus a public "In progress" roadmap.
items: 套餐表格新增「额度」列，展示各套餐包含的 Token / 请求 / Credits 额度。
新增「等效单价」列，折算每千次成本，直观比较性价比。
新增「只看可购买」快捷筛选，一键隐藏售罄与已下线套餐。
新增「数据训练透明度」维度，标注各平台是否将用户数据用于训练。
更新日志页新增「正在推进」路线图，公开功能规划与进度。
额度与等效单价数据同步支持 Excel / Word / PDF 导出。
items_en: Added a Quota column showing the tokens / requests / credits included in each plan.
Added an effective unit-price column (cost per 1K) for at-a-glance value comparison.
Added a "Purchasable only" quick filter to hide sold-out and discontinued plans.
Added a data-training transparency dimension flagging whether each platform trains on user data.
Added an "In progress" roadmap on the changelog page to show planned features and progress.
Quota and unit-price data are also included in Excel / Word / PDF exports.

entries.title: 模型目录与 API 价格对比上线
entries.title_en: Model Catalog and API Price Comparison Are Live
entries.summary: 新增按模型浏览与独立 API 价格页，套餐适配关系和模型使用成本可以在同一站点交叉比较。
entries.summary_en: Browse plans by model and compare official API prices on a dedicated page, bringing model availability and usage cost into one workflow.
items: 订阅套餐新增“按模型”维度，可反查每个模型对应的可用套餐。
新增模型价格对比页，展示厂商、上下文长度及官方输入/输出单价，并支持厂商筛选和排序。
价格数据保留厂商官方计价币种与来源链接，不再强制换算成人民币。
完善模型目录、套餐与模型关联及模型图标，让模型与厂商归属更清晰。
items_en: Browse subscription plans by model to see which plans include each model.
Compare providers, context windows, and official input/output prices on the dedicated model page, with provider filters and sorting.
Prices retain each provider's official billing currency and source links instead of being forcibly converted to CNY.
Improved the model catalog, plan-to-model relationships, and model icons for clearer vendor attribution.
